about_the_game:
Custom Fortress is a community-driven Team Fortress 2 sourcemod that attempts to make TF2 as customizable as possible by removing as much hardcoded elements as possible to make it as easy as possible to create new content, implementing new convars to control every aspect of your server, and lots of new community content included is base game for you to try out including new weapons, taunts, cosmetics, and gamemodes!

New Community Content:

Since we are custom fortress obviously, we want include amazing community content for everyone to enjoy. So far we've added:

  • New Taunts:

    • "The Trust Fall", a new Heavy taunt kill by Lets and Lo-Fi.

    • "Texan Tacklin'", a new Engineer fishing taunt for him to enjoy his downtime.

    • "Mercenary Style", a very familiar dance taunt usable by every class, made by the Custom Fortress Community

    • And more to come!

  • New Weapons:

    • "The Handy Partner", a PDA replacement that allows you to use a Mini-dispenser with a whole new playstyle, made by Neodos & Flying Dutchman.

    • "The Holy Marlin", A new long range melee weapon for Demoman, made by AltraNade & Lolripk.

    • "The Afterburner", A new flamethrower for Pyro that allows for new movement, made by NeoDement.

    • "Conventional", A new Scout & Engineer stealth weapon, made by SVDL .

    • And more to come! For a full list check out the list of items in the in-game catalog!

New Server customization:

To make it as easy as possible for players to customize their experience on locally hosted listen servers various options like:

  • SV_Cheats only for server owners

  • Highlander mode

  • Infinite ammo

  • stock only server

  • And much more!

Check out all the awesome options in our fully custom new server creator!

Newly Restored content:

  • Remember the scrapped "Never Forget hat"? Well we didn't forgot and we brought back the 2 other ball caps as well, the "Mannananas Hat" and the "Mercenary Park".

  • Remember when the sandman could FULLY stun you across the whole map? Well you can now relive those "happy moments" with the convar "cf_scout_stunball_old_stun 1"! We have plans to bring back lots of features as toggle-able options for server owners so you can play the game your way!

  • Ever wish you could use Pretty Boy's Pocket Pistol or the Reverse shooter on other classics? Well now you can use Scouts classic pistols as Engineer like they were originally planned along with soldiers shotguns for engineer and pyro!

  • We've also been able to restore alot of cut weapons including the "Bigger is Better" engineer set that includes the "THE B.M.M.H" shotgun, "The Big Tex" Revolver, and "The Big Bang" wrench! Try them out ingame today!

Want to help contribute to the mod? Join our discord as we are always looking for new things to add and showcase, all with correct permission of course!

short_description: Custom Fortress is a community-driven TF2 sourcemod that attempts to removes hardcoded limits and makes the game fully customizable. With regular updates introducing new community content and general improvements, it allows creators and players to shape the game the way they want to play.
